stories.title: Forecast: First freeze warnings of the season possible next week
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Austin Country Flea Market closing its doors in December
stories.summary: The market will officially close on Dec. 20.

stories.title: HPD: Juveniles find man's body inside abandoned downtown Houston building
stories.summary: Investigators say the juveniles were trespassing in the building when they found the man's body in water that had collected in an elevator area.

stories.title: His sister spent decades searching for answers. She learned he was found just before her death
stories.summary: John Richard Moulis' sister learned he had been identified just two days before her death.

stories.title: Austin Mayor Pro Tem Chito Veta announces campaign for Texas Senate District 14
stories.summary: Vela is looking to fill the seat currently held by Texas Comptroller-elect Sarah Eckhardt, who unseated Republican Don Huffines in the November midterm.

stories.title: Federal agencies issue aviation security warning ahead of busy Thanksgiving travel week
stories.summary: Federal officials are urging airlines to remain vigilant following al Qaeda messaging about aviation attacks ahead of the holiday travel rush.

stories.title: Inmate's escape attempt at Beaumont prison foiled by vigilant TDCJ staff
stories.summary: An inmate at the Larry Gist Unit attempted an escape early Friday but was swiftly recaptured by correctional officers, says the Texas Department of Criminal Justice.

stories.title: Travis County to transform historic horse ranch into new public park
stories.summary: A 952-acre horse ranch near Elgin will become a Travis County park, with plans for public access and community input in the coming years.

stories.title: Lakeway mother asks Travis County to extend road repair project
stories.summary: Travis County plans to repair part of Sutton Drive near Lakeway, but one resident says the project stops short of addressing road conditions that limit her mobility.

stories.title: Family of former MLB pitcher Lance Broadway release statement after unexplained death
stories.summary: Dallas police are currently investigating the death of the former pitcher and actor.

stories.title: Female police officers sue City of Dallas, alleging sex discrimination, retaliation
stories.summary: The two officers allege in the suit that they were harassed due to their sex, and restricted them to partially operational status, stripping them of core duties.

stories.title: Bastrop launches pilot program to help downtown businesses pay for live music
stories.summary: The city will cover 30% of eligible musician fees, reimbursing businesses up to $400 per performance, with a monthly cap of $1,200 per business.
